body.name: Finite path-survival fan
body.construction: \(J=\{\gamma:q_\star\in D_\gamma\}\), \(\mathfrak F(q_\star)\) is the relative sign fan of all inequalities defining \(D_\gamma\) that bind at \(q_\star\), and \(J_F=\{\gamma\in J:F\subseteq T_{D_\gamma}(q_\star)\}\) for every nonempty relative-open face \(F\in\mathfrak F(q_\star)\)
